#### Import packages

```{r, message=FALSE}
library("tidyverse")
```

#### Load data

Import the data from Kaggle ("https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/piotrgrabo/breastcancerproteomes?select=77_cancer_proteomes_CPTAC_itraq.csv")

```{r}
# Create data folders
raw_dir = "../data/_raw"
if(!dir.exists(raw_dir)){
  dir.create(raw_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

# Download data
raw_zip = "../data/_raw/breastcancerproteomes.zip"
if(!file.exists(raw_zip)){
  download.file(
    url = "https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/piotrgrabo/breastcancerproteomes",
    destfile = raw_zip,
    mode = "wb"
  )
}

# Extract data
if(file.exists(raw_zip))
  # Unzip
  unzip(raw_zip,
        exdir = "../data/_raw")

  # Delete ZIP archive after data extraction
  invisible(file.remove(raw_zip))
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# Load datasets into environment
proteomes <- read_csv(str_c("../data/_raw/",
                            "77_cancer_proteomes_CPTAC_itraq.csv"), 
                      show_col_types = FALSE)
clinical <- read_csv(str_c("../data/_raw/",
                           "clinical_data_breast_cancer.csv"),
                     show_col_types = FALSE)
pam50 <- read_csv(str_c("../data/_raw/",
                        "PAM50_proteins.csv"),
                  show_col_types = FALSE)
```

### Write the final dataframes as tsv files in the data folder

```{r}
data_path = "../data/"

write_tsv(x = pam50, 
          file = str_c(data_path, 
                       "01_dat_load_pam50.tsv"))

write_tsv(x = proteomes, 
          file = str_c(data_path, 
                       "01_dat_load_proteomes.tsv"))

write_tsv(x = clinical, 
          file = str_c(data_path, 
                       "01_dat_load_clinical.tsv"))
```
